title: Efficacy of Temocillin compared to standard of care in the Treatment of Neisseria gonorrhoeae Infections: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Non-Inferiority Trial (TEMtoGo).
official: Efficacy of Temocillin compared to standard of care in the Treatment of Neisseria gonorrhoeae Infections: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Non-Inferiority Trial (TEMtoGo).
summary: Main objective: Demonstrate the non-inferiority of 2g IV or IM temocillin treatment compared to the reference treatment with 1g IM ceftriaxone (Standard of Care (SOC)) for Neisseria gonorrhoeae infections at  D21 (negative PCR in urine/vagina, throat and/or anus).

interventions.name: Negaban 2 g poudre pour solution injectable/pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1- Age ≥ 18 years
2. 2- Positive PCR for Ng (urine/vagina and/or throat and/or anus)
3. 3-Asymptomatic Neisseria gonorrhoeae infection
4. 4- Patient who has understood the entirety of the study and accepts its constraints
5. 5-Women of child-bearing potential (i.e. fertile, following menarche and until becoming post-menopaused unless permanently sterile) who are sexually active have to apply a highly effective method of birth control, throughout the study period and for 90 days following the last dose of study treatment.
6. 6- Signature of the consent form for participation in the trial.
7. 7- Affiliation with a Social Security scheme
8. 8- French, English or Spanish speaker
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1 - Known allergy to penicillin, temocillin, ceftriaxone or other beta-lactam antibiotics (grade 3 or 4), hypersensitivity to other cephalosporins, as well as any allergy to one of the excipients.
2. 10 -Known renal or hepatic dysfunction
3. 11 - Patient on curative anticoagulation or known hemostasis disorder (contraindication for the IM route)
4. 12 - Prior participation in this study
5. 13 - Patient under legal guardianship
6. 14 - Participation in another randomized trial or trial concerning a medicinal product or clinical investigation protocol concerning a medical device (<3 months)
7. 15- patients deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision
8. 16- Patients who are the investigator or any other member of the study team, or close relatives of the investigator or persons involved in the study (e.g., assistant physicians, pharmacists, nurses…)
9. 2- Known complete heart block
10. 3- Known hypersensitivity to lidocaine or other amide-type anesthetics
11. 4- Clinical suspicion of hypovolemia
12. 5 - Concomitant antibiotic treatment to be started or in progress for another bacterial infection except for doxycycline as post exposure prophylaxis
13. 6 - BMI> 35 kg/m2
14. 7 - Another ongoing antibiotic therapy < 1 month except for doxycycline as post exposure prophylaxis
15. 8- Complicated upper genital infection
16. 9 - Pregnant or breastfeeding woman (urinary βHCG at baseline)
